headline: Former Air Forces Central (AFCENT) commander Lt. Gen. Derek France says Operation Epic Fury exposed several gaps in U.S. preparation for major combat against a capable state adversary. Air & Space Forces Magazine reports France identified munitions logistics, long range air domain awareness and base survivability as key areas for improvement. U.S. bases continued generating sorties despite repeated Iranian missile and drone attacks, but France said critical command and control facilities and aircrew areas need greater protection. The scale was fundamentally different from decades of counterterrorism operations: more than 13,000 targets were struck while Iran launched more than 1,500 ballistic missiles and 6,000 drones. France's assessment offers a rare look at what the U.S. Air Force learned from conducting sustained, high intensity combat against an adversary capable of repeatedly attacking American forces. Source: https://www.airandspaceforces.com/former-afcent-commander-reflects-on-lessons-of-epic-fury/

headline: The future USS Ted Stevens (DDG-128), a Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided missile destroyer, transited the Panama Canal westbound last week en route to Whittier, Alaska, where it is scheduled to be commissioned into the U.S. Navy on October 3. The destroyer departed HII’s Ingalls Shipbuilding facility in Pascagoula, Mississippi, in May and first sailed to its future homeport at Naval Station Norfolk. The ship has since continued its testing and preparation for commissioning. Following its commissioning in Alaska, Ted Stevens will return to Norfolk, where the crew will continue training, testing and certification ahead of the ship’s eventual entry into the operational fleet. The Ted Stevens is the second Flight III Arleigh Burke-class destroyer built by Ingalls and is equipped with the AN/SPY-6(V)1 air and missile defense radar and upgraded Aegis combat systems.

headline: President Donald J. Trump announced Sunday that the U.S. will remove its tariff on Irish whiskey, currently set at 10%. The tariff had been 15% before being reduced to 10% in July as part of the broader U.S.-EU tariff regime. President Trump made the announcement in Ireland after saying Prime Minister Micheál Martin, Irish Open winner Shane Lowry and others had urged him to remove it. President Trump did not specify when the tariff would actually be eliminated. The move follows his earlier decision to restore zero-tariff treatment for UK whiskey, including Scotch, which took effect in July.

headline: The U.S. Treasury has designated Russia's VTB Bank under Iran sanctions authority E.O. 13902, part of Operation Economic Outcast. According to Treasury, VTB opened offices in Iran and moved to expand its Tehran presence in January 2025, established correspondent banking with sanctioned Iranian banks, took steps to move billions in frozen Iranian assets, and created a rial-ruble settlement system to expand bilateral trade. VTB was already sanctioned under E.O. 13662 and E.O. 14024. The new designation raises secondary-sanctions exposure for foreign banks dealing with it. Treasury urged them to cut ties immediately.
